The '''Dustig Sector Forces''' were the [[Planetary Security Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], they had been mired by corruption and neglect.
